overall_rationale: Across the set, the strongest views use high-contrast active paths, compact legends, and numbered sequencing cues. Differences are modest on many desktop pairs but decisive at 844x390 and 390x844, where the weaker alternatives often shrink the teaching object or allow labels to clip, collide, or become illegible. The preferred narrow variants generally preserve both hierarchy and focus occupancy; some fine labels remain small even in otherwise stronger wide views.
